Name: Shawnee Mission East High School
Description: This is where I went to high school and met so many of my best friends, this school means a lot to me because of the friends I made and the nostalgia from it.

Name: Osteria Il Centro
Description: Il Centro has always been a family favorite and is the best Italian food in Kansas City. The resteraunt is cozy and the service is incredible, seriously one of the best in the KC area.

Name: PowerLife South Plaza
Description: PowerLife is one of my favorite workout spots when I’m home. I love this location because its right next to the plaza, it’s a great place to get a workout in closer to the city.

Name: The Roasterie Café – Brookside
Description: The Roasterie in Brookside has forever and always will be my favorite coffee shop. 16oz Iced Almond Milk Latte is the best order and the occasional spirnkle donut.

Name: Country Club Plaza
Description: Town Center has always been a go-to for shopping, errands, and resteraunts. It’s a staple for me and my friends at home and has so many great stores.

Name: Meadowbrook Park
Description: Meadowbrook Park is one of the prettiest outdoor spots in Prairie Village. I love going on walks or runs there and the Meadowbrook coffee shop and resteraunt is also amazing to stop in before or after a walk.

Name: Milburn Country Club
Description: Milburn has been part of a lot of family events and social memories for me growing up. From growing up swimming and golfing to now coming home to have dinner there and golf from time to time;.

Name: French Market
Description: French Market is a Prairie Village favorite that feels both casual and special. I’ve gone there with family and friends for years. It’s one of those hometown spots I always look forward to visiting when I’m back.

Name: Jun’s Sushi
Address: 95th St & Mission Rd Area, Prairie Village, KS
Description: Jun’s is one of my favorite sushi spots back home. It's a bit of a hole in the wall but it never disappoints, the sushi boat is the best to get with a big group.

Name: Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art
Description: The Nelson-Atkins is such an iconic Kansas City landmark that I show to anyone visiting. Not only is the outside stunning but the museam itself is full of culture and art.
